```js
const radioBUttons = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="rol"]');
const asistente = document.getElementById('asistente');
const organizador = document.getElementById('organizador');
const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const nombre = params.get('nombre');

radioBUttons.forEach(radio => {
    radio.addEventListener('change', () => {
        if (radio.id === 'btnRadioAsistente' && radio.checked) {
            asistente.classList.remove('d-none');
            organizador.classList.add('d-none');
        } else if (radio.id === 'btnRadioOrganizador' && radio.checked) {
            organizador.classList.remove('d-none');
            asistente.classList.add('d-none');
        }
    });
});

const inputFile = document.getElementById('formFile');
const previewImage = document.getElementById('preview');

inputFile.addEventListener('change', () => {
	const file = inputFile.files[0];
    if (file) {
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function (e) {
            previewImage.src = e.target.result;
            previewImage.classList.remove('d-none');
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    } else {
        previewImage.src = '#';
        previewImage.classList.add('d-none');
    }
	
});

const nickname = document.getElementById("nickname");
let nicknameTooltip = tooltip(nickname, "Escribe tu nombre de usuario");
let checkNickname = false;

nickname.addEventListener("focus", function () {
	if (nickname.value.trim() === "" && checkNickname) {
        nicknameTooltip.show();
	}
    nickname.style.borderColor = "";
});

nickname.addEventListener("blur", function () {
    if (nickname.value.trim() === "") {
        nickname.style.borderColor = "red";
		checkNickname = true;
    } else {
        nickname.style.borderColor = "";
		checkNickname = false;
    }
	nicknameTooltip.hide();
});


const nombreInput = document.getElementById("nombre");
let nombreTooltip = tooltip(nombreInput, "Escribe tu nombre");
let checkNombre = false;
nombreInput.addEventListener("focus", function () {
    if (nombreInput.value.trim() === "" && checkNombre) {
        nombreTooltip.show();
    }
    nombreInput.style.borderColor = "";
});
nombreInput.addEventListener("blur", function () {
    if (nombreInput.value.trim() === "") {
        nombreInput.style.borderColor = "red";
		checkNombre = true;
    } else {
        nombreInput.style.borderColor = "";
		checkNombre = false;
    }
    nombreTooltip.hide();
});

const correo = document.getElementById("correo");
let emailTooltip = tooltip(correo, "Escribe un correo electrónico válido");
let checkEmail = false;
correo.addEventListener("focus", function () {
    if (correo.value.trim() === "" && checkEmail) {
        emailTooltip.show();
    }
    correo.style.borderColor = "";
});
correo.addEventListener("blur", function () {
    if (correo.value.trim() === "") {
        correo.style.borderColor = "red";
		checkEmail = true;
    } else {
        correo.style.borderColor = "";
		checkEmail = false;
    }
    emailTooltip.hide();
});


const password = document.getElementById("password");
let passwordTooltip = tooltip(password, "La contraseña debe tener al menos 8 caracteres");
let checkPassword = false;
password.addEventListener("focus", function () {
    if (password.value.length < 8 && checkPassword) {
        passwordTooltip.show();
    }
    password.style.borderColor = "";
});
password.addEventListener("blur", function () {
    if (password.value.length < 8) {
        password.style.borderColor = "red";
		checkPassword = true;
    } else {
        password.style.borderColor = "";
		checkPassword = false;
    }
    passwordTooltip.hide();
});


const confirmPassword = document.getElementById("confirmPassword");
let confirmPasswordTooltip = tooltip(confirmPassword, "Las contraseñas no coinciden");
let checkConfirmPassword = false;
confirmPassword.addEventListener("focus", function () {
    if ((confirmPassword.value.trim() === "" || confirmPassword.value !== password.value) && checkConfirmPassword) {
        confirmPasswordTooltip.show();
    }
    confirmPassword.style.borderColor = "";
});
confirmPassword.addEventListener("blur", function () {
    if (confirmPassword.value.trim() === "" || confirmPassword.value !== password.value) {
        confirmPassword.style.borderColor = "red";
		checkConfirmPassword = true;
    } else {
        confirmPassword.style.borderColor = "";
		checkConfirmPassword = false;
    }
    confirmPasswordTooltip.hide();
});

const apellido = document.getElementById("apellido");
let apellidoTooltip = tooltip(apellido, "Escribe tu apellido");
let checkApellido = false;
apellido.addEventListener("focus", function () {
    if (apellido.value.trim() === "" && checkApellido) {
        apellidoTooltip.show();
    }
    apellido.style.borderColor = "";
});
apellido.addEventListener("blur", function () {

        apellido.style.borderColor = "red";

    } else {

    }

});

const grupoFecha = document.getElementById("grupoBtn");
const dia = document.getElementById("dia");
const mes = document.getElementById("mes");
const anio = document.getElementById("anio");
let checkFecha = false;

let fechaTooltip = tooltip(dia, "Selecciona una fecha válida");
grupoFecha.addEventListener("focusin", function () {
    if ((dia.value === "0" || mes.value === "0" || anio.value === "0") && checkFecha) {
		if(!fechaTooltip._isShown())
		{
			fechaTooltip.show();
		}
    }
    dia.style.borderColor = "";
    mes.style.borderColor = "";
    anio.style.borderColor = "";
});
grupoFecha.addEventListener("focusout", function (e) {
    // Verifica si el nuevo foco está fuera del grupo
    if (!grupoFecha.contains(e.relatedTarget)) {
        if (dia.value === "0" || mes.value === "0" || anio.value === "0") {
            dia.style.borderColor = "red";
            mes.style.borderColor = "red";
            anio.style.borderColor = "red";
            checkFecha = true;
        } else {
            dia.style.borderColor = "";
            mes.style.borderColor = "";
            anio.style.borderColor = "";
			checkFecha = false;
        }
		fechaTooltip.hide();
    }
})


function tooltip(element, message) {
	element.setAttribute("data-bs-toggle", "tooltip");
	element.setAttribute("data-bs-placement", "left");
	element.setAttribute("title", message);
	
	return new bootstrap.Tooltip(element, {
		trigger: "manual", 
        offset: [0, 10],
    });
}


const descripcion = document.getElementById("descripcion");
let descripcionTooltip = tooltip(descripcion, "Escribe una descripción breve");
let checkDescripcion = false;

descripcion.addEventListener("focus", function () {
    if (descripcion.value.trim() === "" && checkDescripcion) {
        descripcionTooltip.show();
    }
    descripcion.style.borderColor = "";
});
descripcion.addEventListener("blur", function () {
    if (descripcion.value.trim() === "") {
        descripcion.style.borderColor = "red";
		checkDescripcion = true;
    } else {
        descripcion.style.borderColor = "";
		checkDescripcion = false;
    }
    descripcionTooltip.hide();
});

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
	//nicknameTooltip.hide();
	nombreTooltip.hide();
	emailTooltip.hide();
	passwordTooltip.hide();
	confirmPasswordTooltip.hide();
	apellidoTooltip.hide();
    fechaTooltip.hide();
});

const btnRegistro = document.getElementById("btnRegistro");
btnRegistro.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    let valid = true;

    if (nickname.value.trim() === "") {
        nickname.style.borderColor = "red";
		checkNickname = true;
        valid = false;
    }

    if (nombreInput.value.trim() === "") {
        nombreInput.style.borderColor = "red";
		checkNombre = true;
        valid = false;
    }

    if (correo.value.trim() === "") {
        correo.style.borderColor = "red";
		checkEmail = true;
        valid = false;
    }

    if (password.value.length < 8) {
        password.style.borderColor = "red";
		checkPassword = true;
        valid = false;
    }

    if (confirmPassword.value.trim() === "" || confirmPassword.value !== password.value) {
        confirmPassword.style.borderColor = "red";
		checkConfirmPassword = true;
        valid = false;
    }


	const seleccionado = document.querySelector('input[name="rol"]:checked');
	if (seleccionado && seleccionado.id === "btnRadioAsistente") {
		if (apellido.value.trim() === "") {
		    apellido.style.borderColor = "red";
			checkApellido = true;
		    valid = false;
		}

		if (dia.value === "0" || mes.value === "0" || anio.value === "0") {
		    dia.style.borderColor = "red";
		    mes.style.borderColor = "red";
		    anio.style.borderColor = "red";
		    valid = false;
		    checkFecha = true;
		}
	} else if (seleccionado && seleccionado.id === "btnRadioOrganizador") {
		if (descripcion.value.trim() === "") {
            descripcion.style.borderColor = "red";
			checkDescripcion = true;
			valid = false;
        }
	}
	else {
		valid = false;
	}
	
		

    if (!valid) {
        e.preventDefault(); // Evita el envío del formulario si hay errores
    }
});
```

```css
    display: table-cell !important;
  }
  .d-print-flex {
    display: flex !important;
  }
  .d-print-inline-flex {
    display: inline-flex !important;
  }
  .d-print-none {
    display: none !important;
  }
}
body,
html {
  height: 100%;
}

.feature {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 3rem;
  width: 3rem;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
}

.bg-featured-blog {
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  min-height: 15rem;
}
```

# src\main\webapp\WEB-INF\ediciones\consultaDetalladaEdicion.jsp

```jsp
<%@ page import="datatypes.DTEdicionDetallada, datatypes.DTEdicion, datatypes.DTOrganizador, datatypes.DTUsuario, datatypes.DTAsistente,
	datatypes.DTTipoRegistro, datatypes.DTPatrocinio, datatypes.DTRegistro" %>
<%@ page import="java.util.Date, java.text.SimpleDateFormat" %>
<%@ page language="java" contentType="text/html; charset=UTF-8"
    pageEncoding="UTF-8"%>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
	<title>Consulta Detallada de Edición</title>
	
	<jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/template/head.jsp" />
    <link href="<%= request.getContextPath() %>/media/styles/styles.css" rel="stylesheet">
</head>
<body class="d-flex flex-column h-100 bg-light">
     <!-- NAV -->
     <jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/template/header.jsp" />
     
     <% var edicionDetallada = (DTEdicionDetallada)request.getAttribute("edicionDetallada"); 
        var edicion = edicionDetallada.edicion();
        var organizador = edicionDetallada.organizador();
        var tiposRegistro = edicionDetallada.tiposRegistro();
        var patrocinios = edicionDetallada.patrocinios();
        var registros = edicionDetallada.registros();
        SimpleDateFormat formatter = new SimpleDateFormat("dd/MM/yyyy");
        var dtUsuario = (DTUsuario)request.getAttribute("usuario");
        boolean asistente = dtUsuario instanceof DTAsistente; 
        boolean organizadorUsuario = dtUsuario instanceof DTOrganizador;
     
     %>
     
        <section class="position-relative" id="imagenEd" style="min-height: 500px; background-image: url('<%= request.getContextPath() %>/image/<%=edicion.foto()%>'); background-size: cover; background-position: center;">
        <div class="position-absolute bottom-0 start-0 w-100" style="height: 40%;background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.7), transparent);">
            
            <div class="container h-100 d-flex flex-column justify-content-end pb-4">

                <h1 class="fw-bold text-white fs-2 fs-md-1"><%=edicion.nombre()%></h1>
                <p class="fs-5 fs-md-5 text-white mb-0 fw-bold"><%=edicion.sigla()%></p>

                <div class="row g-2 g-md-3 mt-2 align-items-center">
                    <div class="col-auto d-flex align-items-center">
                        <i class="bi bi-calendar-event-fill text-white me-2"></i>
                        <p class="fs-5 fs-md-5 text-white mb-0"><%= formatter.format(edicion.fechaInicio()) %> - <%=formatter.format(edicion.fechaFin()) %></p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-auto d-flex align-items-center">
                        <i class="bi bi-geo-alt-fill text-white me-2"></i>
                        <p class="fs-5 fs-md-5 text-white mb-0"><%=edicion.ciudad() %>, <%=edicion.pais() %></p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>
    <main class="flex-shrink-0 mt-5 mb-5">
        <div class="container p-5 rounded-4 border bg-white shadow-sm">
            <section>
            <% if (organizadorUsuario) { %>
                <div class="d-flex justify-content-end">
                    <a class="btn btn-outline-primary mb-3 me-2" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#registrosEdicionModal" href="#!">Ver registros</a>
                </div> 
                
            <jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/registro/registrosEdicion.jsp"/>    
           <% } %>     
                
                <h3>Organizador </h3>
                <div class="row g-3 align-items-center mb-4 p-2">
                    <div class="col-auto">
                        <div class="d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center bg-secondary rounded-circle" style="width: 75px; height: 75px; font-size: 2rem;">
                            <img src="<%= request.getContextPath() %>/image/<%=organizador.foto()%>" class="card-img-top" alt="Foto del organizador"/>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="col">
                        <h4><a href="perfil-organizador.html" class="text-decoration-none text-body"><%=organizador.nombre() %></a></h4>
                        <p class="mb-0"><%=organizador.correo()%></p>
                        <p class="mb-0"><%=organizador.descripcion()%></p>
                        <% if(organizador.linkSitioWeb() != null) { %> 
                        	<p class="mb-0"><%=organizador.linkSitioWeb()%></p> 
                        <% } %>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </section>
        </div>
        

       <div class="container p-5 mt-4">
                    <div class="row gx-5 justify-content-center align-items-center align-items-stretch" id="tipoRegistro">
                        <!-- Pricing card free-->
                      <% for(DTTipoRegistro tipoRegistro : tiposRegistro) {
                    	  request.setAttribute("tipoRegistro", tipoRegistro);
                      %>
                        <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-lg-6 col-xl-4 mb-4">
                            <div class="card mb-5 mb-xl-0 h-100 borderh-100">
                                <div class="card-body p-5 d-flex flex-column min-vh-50" style="min-height: 50vh;">
                                    <button type="button" class="btn p-0 m-0 align-self-start" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#<%=tipoRegistro.nombre()%>consultaModal">
                                        <i class="bi bi-question-circle-fill fs-4"></i>
                                    </button>
                                    <div class="small text-uppercase fw-bold text-muted"><%=tipoRegistro.nombre() %></div>
                                    <div class="mb-3">
                                        <span class="display-4 fw-bold">$<%=(int) tipoRegistro.costo()%></span>
                                    </div>
                                    <p><%=tipoRegistro.descripcion()%></p>
                                    
                                    <% if(asistente && !((boolean) request.getAttribute("usuarioRegistrado"))) { 
                                    	request.setAttribute("edicion", edicion); %>
                                    	<div class="d-grid mt-auto"><a class="btn btn-dark rounded-4 fs-5" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#<%=tipoRegistro.nombre() + "registroModal" %>" href="#!">Elegir</a></div>
                                		<jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/registro/altaRegistroEdicion.jsp" />
                                	<% } %>
                                	
                                </div>
                            </div>        
                        </div>
                        <!-- Modal para  registro -->
                        <jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/registro/consultaTipoRegistro.jsp" />
                        
                     <% } %>
                    </div>
        </div>
        
        <% String mensajeError = (String) request.getAttribute("errorRegistro"); 
        if (mensajeError != null) { %>
        <div class="container p-5 mt-4">
        	<div class="border border-danger mb-3" style="background-color: rgba(220, 53, 69, 0.3)"><p class="text-center fw-bold" style="color: black;"><%=mensajeError %></p> </div>
        </div>
        <% } %>
        
        <% if(asistente && ((boolean) request.getAttribute("usuarioRegistrado"))) {     	
        	DTRegistro registroUsuario = (DTRegistro) request.getAttribute("datosRegistroUsuario");
        	%>
        <div class="container p-5 mt-4">
        
        	<div class="border border-success p-2 mb-3 d-flex justify-content-center" style="background-color: rgba(40, 167, 69, 0.3)">
        		<div> 	
        		<p class="fw-bold mb-0 p-0">¡Ya estás registrado a esta edición!<p>
        		<div class="d-flex gap-2 fw-normal">
                    <p class="fw-bold mb-0 p-0">Nickname del usuario registrado: </p>
                    <p class="mb-0 p-0"><%=registroUsuario.nicknameAsistente() %></p>
                </div>
                <div class="d-flex gap-2 fw-normal">
                    <p class="fw-bold mb-0 p-0">Nombre del evento: </p>
                    <p class="mb-0 p-0"><%=registroUsuario.nombreEvento() %></p>
                </div>
                <div class="d-flex gap-2 fw-normal">
                    <p class="fw-bold mb-0 p-0">Nombre de la edición: </p>
                    <p class="mb-0 p-0"><%=registroUsuario.nombreEdicion() %></p>
                </div>
                <div class="d-flex gap-2 fw-normal">
                    <p class="fw-bold mb-0 p-0">Fecha del registro: </p>
                    <p class="mb-0 p-0"><%=formatter.format(registroUsuario.fecha()) %></p>
                </div>
                <div class="d-flex gap-2 fw-normal">
                    <p class="fw-bold mb-0 p-0">Nombre del tipo de registro: </p>
                    <p class="mb-0 p-0"><%=registroUsuario.tipoRegistro().nombre() %></p>
                </div>
                <div class="d-flex gap-2 fw-normal">
                    <p class="fw-bold mb-0 p-0">Costo: </p>
                    <p class="mb-0 p-0">$<%=(int) registroUsuario.costo() %></p>
                </div>
                 <div class="d-flex gap-2 fw-normal">
                    <p class="fw-bold mb-0 p-0">Uso código de patrocinio?: </p>
                    <p class="mb-0 p-0"><%=registroUsuario.usoCodigo() ? "Sí" : "No" %></p>
                </div>               
        		
        		</div>
        		
        	</div>
        
        
        </div>	
        <% } %>
     
    </main>
    <footer class="bg-dark py-4 mt-auto">
    	<div class="container-fluid bg-dark text-white py-4">
            <div class="container text-center">
                <h5 class="mb-0">PATROCINADORES DE LA EDICIÓN</h5>
                <div class ="d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-center align-items-end mt-4">
                <% for(var patrocinio : patrocinios) { %>
                    <a href="#!"class="d-flex flex-column align-items-center text-center col-6 col-md-4 col-lg-3 mb-4 h-100 text-decoration-none text-white"  data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#<%=patrocinio.institucion().nombre()%>patrocinadorModal">
                        <p><%=patrocinio.institucion().nombre()%></p>
                        <img class="img-fluid rounded-pill" src="<%=request.getContextPath() %>/image/<%=patrocinio.institucion().foto().equals("default.png") ? "patrocinadorDefault.png" : patrocinio.institucion().foto() %>" style="width: 100px; height: 100px;" alt="Logo <%=patrocinio.institucion().nombre()%>">
                    </a>
                 <% request.setAttribute("patrocinador", patrocinio); %>
                <jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/ediciones/consultaPatrocinadores.jsp" />
                <% } %>
                </div>
           </div>
    		</div>	
      <div class="container px-3">
        <div
          class="row align-items-center justify-content-between flex-column flex-sm-row"
        >
          <div class="col-auto">
            <div class="small m-0 text-white">
              Copyright &copy; Eventos.uy 2025
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="col-auto">
            <a class="link-light small" href="#!">Privacy</a>
            <span class="text-white mx-1">&middot;</span>
            <a class="link-light small" href="#!">Terms</a>
            <span class="text-white mx-1">&middot;</span>
            <a class="link-light small" href="#!">Contact</a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </footer>
    

    
    
    <!-- Bootstrap core JS-->
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.2.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
    <!-- Core theme JS-->
    <script src="<%= request.getContextPath() %>/media/js/scripts.js"></script>
    
    <!-- Guardamos el atributo en una variable JS -->
    <% String abrirModalTR = (String) request.getAttribute("abrirModal") != null ? (String) request.getAttribute("abrirModal") : ""; 
       request.setAttribute("abrirModal", null);
    %>
    
    <script>
    var abrirModal = '<%= abrirModalTR != null ? abrirModalTR : ""%>';
	</script>
	<% abrirModalTR = null; %>

	<script src="script.js"></script>
	<script src="<%= request.getContextPath() %>/media/js/pages/consultaDetalladaEdicion.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
```

# src\main\webapp\WEB-INF\ediciones\consultaPatrocinadores.jsp

```jsp
<%@ page import="datatypes.DTPatrocinio, datatypes.DTRegistro, datatypes.NivelPatrocinio, java.time.LocalDate, java.time.ZoneId" %>
<%@ page language="java" contentType="text/html; charset=UTF-8"
    pageEncoding="UTF-8"%>

<%

var patrocinador = (DTPatrocinio) request.getAttribute("patrocinador");
String nivel;
if (patrocinador.nivel() == NivelPatrocinio.ORO) {
	nivel = "ORO";
}
else if (patrocinador.nivel() == NivelPatrocinio.PLATINO) {
	nivel = "PLATINO";
}
else if (patrocinador.nivel() == NivelPatrocinio.PLATA) {
	nivel = "PLATA";
}
else {
	nivel = "BRONCE";
}

LocalDate fecha = patrocinador.fechaRealizacion().toInstant().atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()).toLocalDate();
	

%>

<div class="modal fade text-black text-start" id="<%=patrocinador.institucion().nombre()%>patrocinadorModal" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="PatrocinioModalLabel" aria-hidden="true">
        <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered modal-dialog-scrollable modal-fullscreen-sm-down">
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h5 class="modal-title" id="tipoRegistroModalLabel">Información sobre el Patrocinio</h5>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal" aria-label="Close"></button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body p-4" id="infoTipoRegistro">
                    <p>Nombre de la Institución:  <%=patrocinador.institucion().nombre()%></p>
                    <p>Fecha de Realización: <%=fecha %></p>
                    <p>Aporte: $<%=(int) patrocinador.monto()%></p>
                    <p>Nivel: <%=nivel%></p>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-footer p-4">
                    <button class="btn btn-primary w-100 fs-5 rounded-4" data-bs-dismiss="modal" type="button">Cerrar</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    
    
```

# src\main\webapp\WEB-INF\eventos\consultaDetalladaEvento.jsp

```jsp
<%@page import="datatypes.EstadoEdicion"%>
<%@page import="datatypes.DTEdicion"%>
<%@page import="datatypes.DTEventoDetallado"%>
<%@page import="java.util.Date"%>
<%@page import="java.text.SimpleDateFormat"%>
<%@ page language="java" contentType="text/html; charset=UTF-8" pageEncoding="UTF-8"%>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" data-bs-theme="light">
<%
DTEventoDetallado evento = (DTEventoDetallado) request.getAttribute("data_evento");
SimpleDateFormat formatter = new SimpleDateFormat("dd/MM/yyyy");
evento.ediciones();
%>
<head>
    <title>Consulta Detallada de Edición</title>
    
   <jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/template/head.jsp" />
    
</head>
<body class="d-flex flex-column h-100 bg-body-tertiary">
     <!-- NAV -->
     <jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/template/header.jsp" />
 
    <section class="position-relative" style="min-height: 500px; background-image: url('<%=request.getContextPath()%>/image/<%=evento.evento().foto() %>'); background-size: cover; background-position: center;">
        <div class="position-absolute bottom-0 start-0 w-100" style="height: 40%;background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.7), transparent);">
            
            <div class="container h-100 d-flex flex-column justify-content-end pb-4">

                <h1 class="fw-bold text-white fs-2 fs-md-1" id="nombreEvento"><%=evento.evento().nombre() %></h1>
                <p class="fs-5 fs-md-5 text-white mb-0 fw-bold" id="siglaEvento"><%=evento.evento().sigla() %></p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>
    <main class="flex-shrink-0 mt-5 mb-5">
        <div class="container p-5 rounded-4 border bg-body shadow-sm">
            <section class>
                <h3>Descripción </h3>
                <p class="fs-5 fs-md-5" id="descripcionEvento"><%=evento.evento().descripcion() %></p>
                <p class="text-muted fst-italic mb-0">
                      Evento activo desde <%=new SimpleDateFormat("dd/MM/yyyy").format(evento.evento().fechaAlta()) %>
                </p>
                <br>
                <div class="d-flex flex-row flex-md-row gap-2">
                    <% for(String cat : evento.categorias()) { %>
                    	<a class="badge fs-6 fs-md-5 btn btn-primary" id="categoriaEvento" href="<%=request.getContextPath() + "/eventos?categoria=" + cat %>"><%=cat %></a>
                    <% } %>
                </div>
            </section> 
        </div>

        <div class="container my-5">
            <div class="card shadow-sm">
                <div class="card-body row g-3 p-5 edicionesContainer">
                    <h3 class="mb-4">Ediciones</h3>
		            <%if(evento.ediciones().size() == 0){%>
		              <p>Parece que no hay ediciones para este evento.</p>
		            <%}else for (DTEdicion edicion : evento.ediciones()) { String estado = edicion.estado() == EstadoEdicion.ACEPTADA ? "Aceptada" : (edicion.estado() == EstadoEdicion.RECHAZADA ? "Rechazada" : "Ingresada"); %>
                    <jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/ediciones/edicionCard.jsp">
                    	<jsp:param name="nombre" value="<%=edicion.nombre() %>"/>
                        <jsp:param name="sigla" value="<%=edicion.sigla() %>"/>
                        <jsp:param name="ciudad" value="<%=edicion.ciudad()%>"/>
                        <jsp:param name="pais" value="<%=edicion.pais()%>"/>
                        <jsp:param name="fecha_inicio" value="<%=formatter.format(edicion.fechaInicio())%>"/>
                        <jsp:param name="fecha_fin" value="<%=formatter.format(edicion.fechaFin())%>"/>
                        <jsp:param name="estado" value="<%=estado%>"/>
                        <jsp:param name="foto" value="<%=edicion.foto() %>"/>
                    </jsp:include>
                    
                    <%}%>
            </div>
        </div>   
    </main>
</body>
</html>
```

# src\main\webapp\WEB-INF\eventos\listadoEventos.jsp

```jsp
<!DOCTYPE html>
<%@page import="datatypes.TipoUsuario"%>
<html lang="en" data-bs-theme="light">
<%@ page import="java.util.List" %>
<%@ page import="datatypes.DTEvento" %>
	<%
		List<DTEvento> eventos = (List<DTEvento>) request.getAttribute("listado");
		int finPaginacion = (int) request.getAttribute("fin_paginacion");
		int pagina = (Integer)request.getAttribute("pagina") ;
	%>
    <head>
        <title>Eventos UY - Eventos</title>
        <jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/template/head.jsp" />
    </head>
    <body class="d-flex flex-column h-100">
        <main class="flex-shrink-0">
            <!-- NAV -->
    	    <jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/template/header.jsp" />
            <!-- Main section-->
            <section class="p-5" id="main">
                <div class="container mt-5">
                    <div class="text-center mb-5">
                        <h1 class="fw-bolder">Eventos</h1>
                    </div>
                <div class="card shadow-sm">
                    <div class="row g-3 card-body">
                    <% for (DTEvento ev : eventos){ %>
                        <div class="col-xl-3 col-lg-4 col-sm-6 col-12">
                            <a href="<%=request.getContextPath() %>/evento/<%= ev.nombre() %>" class="text-decoration-none">
                                <div class="card h-100 shadow-sm border-0 text-start evento-card position-relative overflow-hidden" style="transition: box-shadow 0.3s;">
                                    <img
                                        class="card-img-top"
                                        src="image/<%= ev.foto()%>"
                                        alt="Banner evento"
                                        style="aspect-ratio: 600/350;"
                                    />
                                    <div class="card-body">
                                        <span class="text-muted text-deco:ration-none"><%=ev.nombre() %></span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="evento-descripcion position-absolute top-0 start-0 w-100 h-100 bg-white p-3 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center text-center" style="opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition: opacity 0.3s;">
                                        <span class="text-muted"><%= ev.descripcion() %></span>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </a>
                        </div>
                        <% } %>
                        <script>
                        document.querySelectorAll('.evento-card').forEach(card => {
                            card.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                                card.style.boxShadow = "0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)";
                                card.style.transform = "scale(1.05)";
                                card.querySelector('.evento-descripcion').style.opacity = "1";
                                card.querySelector('.evento-descripcion').style.pointerEvents = "auto";
                            });
                            card.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                                card.style.boxShadow = "";
                                card.style.transform = "";
                                card.querySelector('.evento-descripcion').style.opacity = "0";
                                card.querySelector('.evento-descripcion').style.pointerEvents = "none";
                            });
                        });
                        </script>

                  </div>
                    <div class="card-footer border-top-0">
                        <nav class="d-flex justify-content-center">
                            <ul class="pagination m-0">
                                <li class="page-item <%= pagina == 1 ? "disabled" : "" %>">
                                    <span class="page-link"><i class="bi bi-caret-left-fill"></i></span>
                                </li>
                                <% for(int i = 1; i <= finPaginacion; i++) { %>
	                                <% if(i==pagina) { %>
		                                <li class="page-item active">
		                                    <span class="page-link"><%= i %></span>
		                                </li>
	                                <% } else{ %>
	                                <li class="page-item">
	                                    <a class="page-link" href="usuarios?pagina=<%=i%>"><%= i %></a>
	                                </li>
	                                
                                <% }} %>
                                <li class="page-item <%= pagina == finPaginacion ? "disabled" : "" %>">
                                    <a class="page-link" href="#"><i class="bi bi-caret-right-fill"></i></a>
                                </li>
                                </ul>
                        
 </nav>
                    </div>
                </div>
                
            </section>
        </main>
       
        <!-- Bootstrap core JS-->
        <script src="js/bootstrap.min.js"></script>
        <!-- Core theme JS-->
        <script src="js/scripts.js"></script>
    </body>
</html>
```

```jsp
<%@ page language="java" contentType="text/html; charset=UTF-8" pageEncoding="UTF-8"%>
<%@ page import="java.util.List" %>
<%@ page import="java.util.Set" %>
<%@ page import="datatypes.DTEvento" %>
<%@ page import="datatypes.DTEventoDetallado" %>
<%@ page import="datatypes.DTUsuario" %>
<%
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    List<DTEventoDetallado> eventosDestacados = (List<DTEventoDetallado>) request.getAttribute("eventosDestacados");
    Boolean sesionIniciada = (Boolean) request.getAttribute("sesionIniciada");
    DTUsuario usuarioLogueado = (DTUsuario) request.getAttribute("usuarioLogueado");
    Integer totalEventos = (Integer) request.getAttribute("totalEventos");
    Integer totalEdiciones = (Integer) request.getAttribute("totalEdiciones");
    
    if (sesionIniciada == null) sesionIniciada = false;
    if (totalEventos == null) totalEventos = 0;
    if (totalEdiciones == null) totalEdiciones = 0;
%>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es" data-bs-theme="light">
  <head>

        <!-- Bootstrap & Icons -->

        <jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/template/head.jsp" />
      </head>
      <body class="d-flex flex-column min-vh-100">
        <jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/template/header.jsp" />

        <main class="flex-grow-1">

                            name="q"
                            type="search"

                      </div>

                        />

                        <div class="carousel-caption text-start">

                    <button

                      data-bs-target="#heroCarousel"

                <div class="col-6 col-md-3">
                  <div class="stat p-3 text-center">

                      <span class="counter" data-to="<%= totalEdiciones %>"

                      >+

                <div class="col-6 col-md-3">

                      <span class="counter" data-to="95">0</span>%
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-muted small">Satisfacción</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div class="col-6 col-md-3">
                  <div class="stat p-3 text-center">

                      <span class="counter" data-to="20">0</span>+
                    </div>

          <!-- Destacados -->

                    >

              </div>
              <% } %>
            </div>
          </section>

          <!-- Testimonio + FAQ -->
          <section class="py-5 bg-light">

                  <div class="text-center text-lg-start">
                    <div class="fs-5 mb-3 fst-italic">
                      “Eventos.uy nos simplificó todo. Registro sin filas y
                      edición confirmada en horas.”
                    </div>
                    <div
                      class="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center justify-content-lg-start"
                    >
                      <img
                        class="rounded-circle me-3"
                        src="https://dummyimage.com/48x48/ced4da/6c757d"

                      />
                      <div class="fw-semibold">
                        Aitor Tilla <span class="text-primary">/</span> CEO,
                        FIngVinci
                      </div>

                </div>
                <div class="col-12 col-lg-6" id="faq">
                  <div class="accordion" id="faqAcc">
                    <div class="accordion-item">

                        </div>

                    </div>

                      <h2 class="accordion-header">

                          ¿Cobran comisión?

                      </h2>
                      <div
                        id="f2"
                        class="accordion-collapse collapse"

                      >
                        <div class="accordion-body">
                          Tenemos planes flexibles según lo que necesites:

                    <div class="accordion-item">

        <!-- FOOTER -->
        <footer class="bg-dark py-4 mt-auto">

        <!-- Scripts -->
        <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
        <script>
          // Contadores animados al entrar en viewport
          const counters = document.querySelectorAll(".counter");
          const io = new IntersectionObserver(
            (entries, obs) => {
              entries.forEach((entry) => {
                if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
                const el = entry.target;
                const to = +el.dataset.to || 0;
                const dur = 1000;
                const start = performance.now();
                (function tick(now) {
                  const p = Math.min((now - start) / dur, 1);
                  el.textContent = Math.floor(p * to);
                  if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
                })(start);
                obs.unobserve(el);
              });
            },
            { threshold: 0.6 }
          );
          counters.forEach((c) => io.observe(c));
        </script>
      </body>
    </html>
```

```jsp
<%@ page import="datatypes.DTEdicion, datatypes.DTTipoRegistro, datatypes.DTUsuario, datatypes.DTAsistente" %>
<%@ page language="java" contentType="text/html; charset=UTF-8"
    pageEncoding="UTF-8"%>

<%

var edicion = (DTEdicion) request.getAttribute("edicion");
var tipoRegistro = (DTTipoRegistro) request.getAttribute("tipoRegistro");
var dtUsuario = (DTUsuario) request.getAttribute("usuario");
var dtAsistente = (DTAsistente) dtUsuario;

%>

  
  <div class="modal fade" id="<%=tipoRegistro.nombre()%>registroModal" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="registroModalLabel" aria-hidden="true">
        <div class="modal-dialog modal-fullscreen-sm-down modal-dialog-centered modal-dialog-scrollable">
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h5 class="modal-title" id="registroModalLabel">Registro a Edición de Evento</h5>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal" aria-label="Close"></button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body p-4">
                    <div class="d-flex justify-content-start mb-3" style="background-image: url('<%= request.getContextPath() %>/image/<%=edicion.foto()%>'); height: 75px; background-size: cover; background-position:center;">
                        <h4 class="ms-3 fs-5 text-white fw-bold" style="line-height: 75px;"><%=edicion.nombre() %></h4>
                    </div>
                    <form action="<%= request.getContextPath()%>/edicion/<%= edicion.nombre().replace(" ", "-") %>" method="POST">
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <label for="nickname" class="col-form-label">Nickname:</label>
                            <input type="text" class="form-control" id="nickname" name="nickname" value="<%=dtAsistente.nickname()%>" disabled>
                        </div>
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <label for="nombre" class="col-form-label">Nombre:</label>
                            <input type="text" class="form-control" id="nombre" value="<%=dtAsistente.nombre()%>" disabled>
                        </div>
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <label for="apellido" class="col-form-label">Apellido:</label>
                            <input type="text" class="form-control" id="apellido" value="<%=dtAsistente.apellido()%>" disabled>
                        </div>
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <label for="email" class="col-form-label">Correo electrónico:</label>
                            <input type="email" class="form-control" id="correo" value="<%=dtAsistente.correo()%>" disabled>
                        </div>
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <label for="tipoEntrada" class="col-form-label">Tipo de Entrada:</label>
                            <input type="tipoEntrada" class="form-control" id="tipoEntrada" value="<%=tipoRegistro.nombre() %> - $<%=tipoRegistro.costo()%>" disabled>
                        </div>
                        <input type="hidden" name="nickname" value="<%=dtAsistente.nickname()%>">
                        <input type="hidden" name="nombreEdicion" value="<%= edicion.nombre() %>">
                        <input type="hidden" name="nombreTipoRegistro" value="<%= tipoRegistro.nombre() %>">
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <label for="codigoPatrocinio" class="col-form-label">Código de Patrocinio:</label>
                            <div class="input-group position-relative">
                                <input type="text" class="form-control" id="codigoPatrocinio" name="codigoPatrocinio" value="<%= (request.getAttribute("abrirModal") != null && request.getAttribute("abrirModal").equals(tipoRegistro.nombre()) && request.getAttribute("codigoIngresado") != null) ? request.getAttribute("codigoIngresado") : "" %>">
                                <button class="btn btn-outline-primary ms-2" type="submit" name="action" value="validarCodigo" id="validarCodigo">Validar</button>
                                
                                                    <!-- Contenedor el toast -->
					<div class="position-absolute bottom-0 ms-3 mb-4 end-0 p-3" style="z-index: 11">
					    <div class="toast align-items-center text-bg-danger border-0" id="toastError" role="alert">
					        <div class="d-flex">
					            <div class="toast-body">El código está vacío</div>
					            <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white me-2 m-auto" data-bs-dismiss="toast"></button>
					        </div>
					    </div>
					</div>
                                
                                
                            </div>
							<%
							Boolean codigoValido = (Boolean) request.getAttribute("codigoValido");
							if (request.getAttribute("abrirModal") != null && codigoValido != null && request.getAttribute("abrirModal").equals(tipoRegistro.nombre())) {
							%>
							    <p class="<%= codigoValido ? "text-success" : "text-danger" %> fs-6 mt-2">
							        <%= codigoValido ? "El código ingresado es correcto" : "El código ingresado es incorrecto" %>
							    </p>
							<% } %>
						</div>
                    <h4 class="mt-4 text-end">Total a Pagar: $<%=tipoRegistro.costo()%></h4>
                    <div class="input-group d-flex justify-content-end mt-4 mb-4">
                        <button class="btn btn-primary text-end" type="submit" name="action" value="confirmarRegistro" id="confirmarRegistro">Confirmar Registro</button>
                        <button class="btn btn-outline-secondary ms-2" data-bs-dismiss="modal" type="button" id="cancelarRegistro">Cancelar</button>
                    </div>
                    </form>
                    
                    
                    
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
```

```jsp
<%@ page import="datatypes.DTEdicionDetallada, datatypes.DTRegistro, java.time.LocalDate, java.time.ZoneId" %>
<%@ page language="java" contentType="text/html; charset=UTF-8"
    pageEncoding="UTF-8"%>

<% var edicionDetallada = (DTEdicionDetallada)request.getAttribute("edicionDetallada");
   var registros = edicionDetallada.registros();		  
%>

<style>

details summary {
  list-style: none;      /* quita la flecha nativa */
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

details[open] .bi-arrow-right-short {
    transform: rotate(90deg); /* flecha apunta hacia abajo */
    transition: transform 0.2s;
}

</style>

    <div class="modal fade" id="registrosEdicionModal" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="registrosEdicionLabel" aria-hidden="true">
        <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered modal-dialog-scrollable modal-fullscreen-sm-down">
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h5 class="modal-title" id="registrosEdicionLabel">Registros a la Edición</h5>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal" aria-label="Close"></button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body p-4">               
                   <ol class="list-group" id="registroUsuarios">
                   <% for(DTRegistro registro : registros) { 
                	   LocalDate fecha = registro.fecha().toInstant().atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()).toLocalDate();
                   
                   %>
                   		
                         <li class="list-group-item d-flex align-items-start flex-wrap p-4" >
						 <details>
						 	<summary>
						 	<i class="bi bi-arrow-right-short"></i>
                            <div class="row g-3 w-100">
                                <div class="d-flex align-items-center col-8">
                                    <img class="rounded-1 align-self-center" src="<%=request.getContextPath()%>/image/<%=registro.fotoAsistente()%>" style="width: 40px; height: 40px;">
                                
                                    <div class="ms-3 w-100 mb-0 p-0">
                                        <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2">
                                            <p class="fw-bold mb-0"><%=registro.nicknameAsistente()%></p>
                                            <span class="badge text-bg-primary rounded-pill align-self-center"><%=registro.tipoRegistro().nombre() %></span>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            </summary>
                            <div class="pt-1 ms-4 text-muted">
                      	        		<div class="mb-0 mt-0 p-0 d-flex gap-2">
                            	        	<p class="fw-bold mb-0 p-0">Tipo de registro: </p>
                            	        	<p class="mb-0 p-0"><%=registro.tipoRegistro().nombre() %></p>
                            	        </div>
                            	        <div class="mb-0 mt-0 p-0 d-flex gap-2">
                            	        	<p class="fw-bold mb-0 p-0">Fecha de registro: </p>
                            	        	<p class="mb-0 p-0"><%=fecha %></p>
                            	        </div>
                                        <div class="mb-0 mt-0 p-0 d-flex gap-2">
                                        	<p class="fw-bold">Uso de código:</p>
                                        	<i class="bi text-primary <%=registro.usoCodigo() ? "bi bi-check-circle-fill" : "bi-x-circle-fill"%>"></i>
                                        </div>
                            </div>
                        </details>
                        </li>                  
					
                   
                                   
                   <% } %>
                   </ol>        
                   
           
                  
                </div>  
                <div class="modal-footer p-4">
                    <button class="btn btn-primary w-100 fs-5 rounded-4" data-bs-dismiss="modal" type="button">Cerrar</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
```

# src\main\webapp\WEB-INF\registro\registroUsuario.jsp

```jsp
<%@ page import="java.time.LocalDate, java.util.Set, java.util.Map, datatypes.DTInstitucion" %>
<%@ page contentType="text/html" pageEncoding="UTF-8" %>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Registro de Usuario</title>
    <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.5.0/font/bootstrap-icons.css" rel="stylesheet" />
    
    <link href="media/css/styles.css" rel="stylesheet" />
    <link href="media/css/sb-admin-2.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
    <jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/template/head.jsp" />
</head>
    <body class="d-flex flex-column h-100 bg-primary">
        
    <style>    
.tooltip .tooltip-inner {
    background-color: #be4b49 !important;
    color: white !important;
    padding: 9px;
    font-size: 14px;
}

 .tooltip {
  --bs-tooltip-bg: #be4b49;
}
	

    </style>
     <!-- NAV -->
     <jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/template/header.jsp" />

    <div class="container mt-5 py-5">
      <div class="card mx-auto shadow" style="max-width: 600px;">
                <div class="card-header bg-white text-center">
                    <h2 class="fw-bold" style="color: black;">Crea una cuenta</h2>
                </div>
                <div class="card-body p-4">
                    <form action="<%= request.getContextPath()%>/registro" method="POST" enctype="multipart/form-data">
                    
                		<%
                		String error = (String) request.getAttribute("error");
                		if (error != null) {
                			
                		%>
            			<div class="border border-danger mb-3" style="background-color: rgba(220, 53, 69, 0.3)"><p class="text-center fw-bold" style="color: black;"><%=error%></p> </div>
                		<% } %>
                		
                        <div class="form-floating mb-3 text-muted">
                            <input type="text" class="form-control" name="nickname" id="nickname" placeholder="Nombre de usuario">
                            <label for="nickname">Nombre de usuario</label>
                        </div>
                        <div class="form-floating mb-3 text-muted">
                            <input type="text" class="form-control" name="nombre" id="nombre" placeholder="Nombre">
                            <label for="nombre">Nombre</label>
                        </div>
                        <div class="form-floating mb-3 text-muted">
                            <input type="text" class="form-control" name="correo" id="correo" placeholder="Correo electrónico">
                            <label for="correo">Correo electrónico</label>
                        </div>
                        <div class="form-floating mb-3 text-muted">
                            <input type="password" class="form-control" name="password" id="password" placeholder="Contraseña">
                            <label for="password" class="form-label">Contraseña</label>
                        </div>
                        <div class="form-floating mb-3 text-muted">
                            <input type="password" class="form-control" id="confirmPassword" placeholder="Confirma tu contraseña">
                            <label for="confirmPassword" class="form-label">Confirmar Contraseña</label>
                        </div>

                        <p class="mb-3 text-muted">Rol <i class="bi bi-question-circle-fill ms-1"></i></p>

                        <div class="btn-group mb-3 w-100" role="group" aria-label="Basic radio toggle button group">
                            <div class="form-check form-check-inline">
                                <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="rol" value="asistente" id="btnRadioAsistente" autocomplete="off" checked>
                                <label class="form-check-label" for="btnRadioAsistente">Asistente</label>
                            </div>
                            <div class="form-check form-check-inline">
                                <input class="form-check-input" type="radio" name="rol" value="organizador" id="btnRadioOrganizador" autocomplete="off">
                                <label class="form-check-label" for="btnRadioOrganizador">Organizador</label>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        <div class="asistente-campos" id="asistente">
                            <div class="mb-3 form-floating text-muted">
                                <input type="text" class="form-control" name="apellido" id="apellido" placeholder="Apellido">
                                <label for="apellido">Apellido</label>
                            </div>
                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <p>Fecha de nacimiento</p>
                                <div class ="row g-3" id="grupoBtn">
                                    <div class="col-3">
                                    <select class="form-select" aria-label="Día" name="dia" id="dia">
                                        <option value="0" selected>Día</option>
                                        <% 
                                        	for (int i =1; i <=31; i++) {
 
                                        %>
                                        		<option value="<%=i%>"><%=i%></option>
                                        
										<% } %>
                                    </select>                                      
                                </div>
                                <div class="col-5">
                                    <select class="form-select" aria-label="Mes" name="mes" id="mes">
                                        <option value="0" selected>Mes</option>
                                        <%
                                        String[] meses = {"Enero", "Febrero", "Marzo", "Abril", "Mayo", "Junio", "Julio", "Agosto", "Septiembre", "Octubre", "Noviembre", "Diciembre"};
                                        for (int i = 0; i < meses.length; i++) {
                                        	 %>
                                        	 <option value="<%=i+1%>"><%=meses[i]%></option> 	
                                        <% } %> 
                                    </select>
                                </div>
                                <div class="col-4">
                                    <select class="form-select" aria-label="Año" name="anio" id="anio">
                                        <option value="0" selected>Año</option>
                                        <%
                                        var anioActual = LocalDate.now().getYear();
                                        for (int i = 0; i <= 120; i++) {
                                        %>
                                        	<option value="<%=anioActual-i%>"><%=anioActual-i%></option>            
                                        <% } %>
                                        
                                    </select>
                                </div>  
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <p>Institución (opcional)</p>
                                <select class="form-select" name="institucion" aria-label="Institución" id="institucion">
                                    <option value="ninguna" selected>- Elección de institución -</option>
                                    <%
                                   	var instituciones = (Set<DTInstitucion>) request.getAttribute("instituciones");
                                    for (var institucion : instituciones) {
                                    	%>
                                    	<option value="<%=institucion.nombre()%>"><%=institucion.nombre()%></option>	
                                    	
                                    <% } %>
                                   
                                </select>
                            </div>   
                        </div>

                        <div class="organizador-campos d-none" id="organizador">
                            <div class="mb-3 form-floating text-muted">
                                <input type="text" class="form-control" name="descripcion" id="descripcion" placeholder="Descripción">
                                <label for="descripcion">Descripción</label>
                            </div>
                            <div class="mb-3 form-floating text-muted">
                                <input type="text" class="form-control" name="sitioWeb" id="sitioWeb" placeholder="Sitio web (opcional)">
                                <label for="sitioWeb">Sitio web (opcional)</label>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div>
                            <label for="formFile" class="form-label">Imagen (opcional)</label>
                            <br>
                            <img class="d-none mt-2 mb-2" id="preview" src="" alt="Vista Previa" style="max-width:200px; max-height:200px;">
                            <input class="form-control" name="imagen" type="file" id="formFile" accept="image/*">
                        </div>

                        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary w-100 mt-5" id="btnRegistro">Registrarse</button>
                        <p class="text-center mt-2"><a href="sesion" class="text-decoration-none">¿Ya tienes una cuenta? </a></p>
                    </form>
                </div>
        </div> 
    </div>
    <!-- Bootstrap core JS-->
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.2.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
    <!-- Core theme JS-->
    <script src="media/js/scripts.js"></script>
    <script src="media/js/pages/registroUsuario.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
```

```jsp
<%@page import="org.apache.commons.lang3.ObjectUtils.Null"%>
<%@ page language="java" contentType="text/html; charset=UTF-8"
    pageEncoding="UTF-8"%>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">


<% String message = (String) request.getAttribute("alert_message"); request.setAttribute("alert_message", null); %>

<head>
    <title>EventosUY - Login</title>
    <jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/template/head.jsp" />
</head>

<body class="bg-gradient-primary">
    

    <div class="container">

        <!-- Outer Row -->
        <div class="row justify-content-center">

            <div class="col-lg-6 col-md-8 col-sm-10 col-12">

                <div class="card o-hidden border-0 shadow-lg my-5">
                    <div class="card-body p-0">
                        <!-- Nested Row within Card Body -->
                        <div class="row">
                            <!-- <div class="col-lg-6 d-none d-lg-block bg-login-image"></div> -->
                            <div class="col-lg-12">
                                <div class="p-5">
                                	<div class="alert alert-warning alert-dismissible fade show" role="alert" id="alert" <%= message != null ? "" : "hidden" %>>
                                		<%= message != null ? message : "" %>
									  <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="alert" aria-label="Close"></button>
									</div>
                                    <div class="text-center">
                                        <h1 class="h4 text-gray-900 mb-4">Bienvenido</h1>
                                    </div>
                                    <form id="loginForm" action="sesion" method="get">
                                    <div class="form-floating mb-3">
                                        <input class="form-control" id="usuario" name="usuario" type="text" placeholder="Enter your name..." required/>
                                        <label for="usuario">Nickname o correo electrónico</label>
                                        <div class="invalid-feedback" data-sb-feedback="usuario:required">Debe ingresar un nickname o correo electrónico</div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="form-floating mb-3">
                                        <input class="form-control" id="clave" name="clave" type="password" placeholder="name@example.com" minlength="8" required/>
                                        <label for="clave">Contraseña</label>
                                        <div class="invalid-feedback" data-sb-feedback="clave:required">Debe ingresar su contraseña</div>
                                    </div>
                                    <!-- Submit success message-->
                                    <!---->
                                    <!-- This is what your users will see when the form-->
                                    <!-- has successfully submitted-->
                                    <div class="d-none" id="submitSuccessMessage">
                                        <div class="text-center mb-3">
                                            <div class="fw-bolder">Form submission successful!</div>
                                            To activate this form, sign up at
                                            <br />
                                            <a href="https://startbootstrap.com/solution/contact-forms">https://startbootstrap.com/solution/contact-forms</a>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <!-- Submit error message-->
                                    <!---->
                                    <!-- This is what your users will see when there is-->
                                    <!-- an error submitting the form-->
                                    <div class="d-none" id="submitErrorMessage"><div class="text-center text-danger mb-3">Error sending message!</div></div>
                                    <!-- Submit Button-->
                                    <div class="d-grid"><button class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" id="submitButton" type="submit" form="loginForm">Iniciar Sesión</button></div>
                                </form>
                                    <hr>
                                    <div class="text-center">
                                        <a class="small" href="registro">Crea tu cuenta!</a>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

            </div>

        </div>

    </div>

    <!-- Bootstrap core JavaScript-->
    <script src="vendor/jquery/jquery.min.js"></script>
    <script src="vendor/bootstrap/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>

    <!-- Core plugin JavaScript-->
    <script src="vendor/jquery-easing/jquery.easing.min.js"></script>
    

    

</body>

</html>
```

```jsp
<%@ page language="java" contentType="text/html; charset=UTF-8" pageEncoding="UTF-8"%>
<%@ page import="model.EstadoSesion"%>
<%@ page import="controllers.SessionManager"%>
<%@ page import="datatypes.DTUsuario"%>
<%@ page import="datatypes.TipoUsuario"%> 
<%
SessionManager.initSesion(request); 
EstadoSesion estadoSesion = (EstadoSesion) request.getSession().getAttribute("estado_sesion");
DTUsuario usuarioLogueado = (DTUsuario) request.getSession().getAttribute("usuario_logueado");
String urlPerfil = "";
if (usuarioLogueado != null) {
  if (usuarioLogueado.getTipo() == TipoUsuario.ASISTENTE) {
    urlPerfil = request.getContextPath() + "/perfil?nickname=" + usuarioLogueado.nickname() + "&tipo=asistente";
  } else {
    urlPerfil = request.getContextPath() + "/perfil?nickname=" + usuarioLogueado.nickname() + "&tipo=organizador";
  }
}
%>
<!-- NAV -->
<style>
  :root {
    --brand: #6f42c1;
    --brand-2: #0d6efd;
  }
  .navbar-blur {
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    background: rgba(33, 37, 41, 0.8) !important;
  }
  .hero {
    position: relative;
    min-height: 75vh;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    overflow: clip;
    color: #fff;
  }
  .hero video,
  .hero .hero-img {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    filter: brightness(0.55);
  }
  .hero::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(
        1200px 600px at 20% 20%,
        rgba(111, 66, 193, 0.35),
        transparent 50%
      ),
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(13, 110, 253, 0.25), transparent 60%),
      linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25));
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .hero-content {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
  }
  .chip {
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
    color: #fff;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    display: inline-flex;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    align-items: center;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
  }
  .chip:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }
  .search-wrap {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
    border-radius: 1rem;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) inset,
      0 8px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  }
  .stat {
    border-radius: 1rem;
    background: linear-gradient(
      145deg,
      rgba(13, 110, 253, 0.1),
      rgba(111, 66, 193, 0.1)
    );
    border: 1px solid rgba(13, 110, 253, 0.15);
  }
  .card-hover:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    box-shadow: 0 1rem 2rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) !important;
  }
  .logo-cloud img {
    opacity: 0.6;
    transition: opacity 0.2s;
    filter: grayscale(1);
  }
  .logo-cloud img:hover {
    opacity: 1;
    filter: none;
  }

  /* Pequeñas animaciones */
  @keyframes float {
    from {
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
    50% {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
    }
    to {
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
  }
  .float {
    animation: float 5s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  [data-bs-theme="dark"] .search-wrap {
    background: rgba(33, 37, 41, 0.9);
    color: #fff;
  }
  [data-bs-theme="dark"] .chip {
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
  }
</style>
<nav class="navbar navbar-expand-lg navbar-dark fixed-top navbar-blur">
  <div class="container">
    <a
      class="navbar-brand fw-semibold"
      href="<%=request.getContextPath()%>/inicio"
    >
      <i class="bi bi-stars me-2 text-warning"></i>Eventos<span
        class="text-primary"
        >.uy</span
      >
    </a>
    <button
      class="navbar-toggler"
      type="button"
      data-bs-toggle="collapse"
      data-bs-target="#nav"
    >
      <span class="navbar-toggler-icon"></span>
    </button>
```

# src\main\webapp\WEB-INF\usuarios\listadoUsuarios.jsp

```jsp
<!DOCTYPE html>
<%@page import="datatypes.TipoUsuario"%>
<html lang="en" data-bs-theme="light">
<%@ page import="java.util.List" %>
<%@ page import="datatypes.DTUsuarioItemListado" %>
	<%
		List<DTUsuarioItemListado> usuarios = (List<DTUsuarioItemListado>) request.getAttribute("listado");
		int finPaginacion = (int) request.getAttribute("fin_paginacion");
		int pagina = (Integer)request.getAttribute("pagina") ;
	%>
    <head>
    	        <title>Eventos UY - Usuarios</title>
        <jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/template/head.jsp" />
    </head>
    <body class="d-flex flex-column h-100">
        <jsp:include page="/WEB-INF/template/header.jsp" />
        <main class="flex-shrink-0">
            <!-- Main section-->
            <section class="p-5 mt-5" id="main">
                <div class="container">
                    <div class="text-center mb-5">
                        <h1 class="fw-bolder">Listado completo de usuarios</h1>
                    </div>
                <div class="card shadow-sm">
                    <div class="card-body p-0">
                    
                        <div class="list-group rounded-bottom-0">
                        
                    		<% for(DTUsuarioItemListado usu: usuarios) { %>
                            <a 
                            class="list-group-item list-group-item-action d-flex border-start-0 border-end-0" 
                            href="perfil?tipo=<%=(usu.tipoUsuario() == TipoUsuario.ASISTENTE) ? "asistente" : "organizador" %>&nickname=<%=usu.nickname()%>">
                                <img class="rounded-1 align-self-center" src="image/<%=usu.foto()%>" style="width: 40px; height: 40px;">
	                                <div class="ms-3">
	                                    <div class="fw-bold">
	                                        <%=usu.nickname()%>
	                                        <span class="badge text-bg-<%=(usu.tipoUsuario() == TipoUsuario.ASISTENTE) ? "primary" : "danger" %>" rounded-pill align-self-center"><%=(usu.tipoUsuario() == TipoUsuario.ASISTENTE) ? "Asistente" : "Organizador" %></span>
	                                    </div>
	                                    <div class="small"><%=usu.correo()%></div>
	                                </div>
                            </a>
                            <% } %>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="card-footer border-top-0">
                        <nav class="d-flex justify-content-center">
                            <ul class="pagination m-0">
                                <li class="page-item <%= pagina == 1 ? "disabled" : "" %>">
                                    <span class="page-link"><i class="bi bi-caret-left-fill"></i></span>
                                </li>
                                <% for(int i = 1; i <= finPaginacion; i++) { %>
	                                <% if(i==pagina) { %>
		                                <li class="page-item active">
		                                    <span class="page-link"><%= i %></span>
		                                </li>
	                                <% } else{ %>
	                                <li class="page-item">
	                                    <a class="page-link" href="usuarios?pagina=<%=i%>"><%= i %></a>
	                                </li>
	                                
                                <% }} %>
                                <li class="page-item <%= pagina == finPaginacion ? "disabled" : "" %>">
                                    <a class="page-link" href="#"><i class="bi bi-caret-right-fill"></i></a>
                                </li>
                                </ul>
                        
 </nav>
                    </div>
                </div>
                </div>
                
            </section>
        </main>
        <!-- Bootstrap core JS-->
        <script src="js/bootstrap.min.js"></script>
        <!-- Core theme JS-->
        <script src="js/scripts.js"></script>
    </body>
</html>
```
